title: Canonical completed pullback equals open restriction on complete inputs
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-open-immersion]. Use small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and put $B_{n,W}=(A_n)_W$, $R_W=\lim_nB_{n,W}$ for $W=X,U$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. On module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $r$ be ordinary site restriction to $U$ followed by scalar transport from $R_X|_U$ to $R_U$ via the inverse of the canonical constant-section-preserving ring isomorphism. Let $r_n$ denote the analogous finite restriction. Apply these exact functors termwise to get $D(r),D(r_n)$ on ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

For any $K\in D(R_X)$, write $K_n=K\otimes^L_{R_X}B_{n,X}$. Use the functorial strict quotient-tower definition of integral pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], its finite pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. There is a natural isomorphism
$$D(r)\bigl(R\lim_n\operatorname{Res}_nK_n\bigr)\xrightarrow{\sim}Lj^*_{\mathcal O_E}K.$$
It is induced before localization by the product and shifted-Roos-cone comparisons on one flat-term K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex], with level comparison the canonical finite inverse-image/restriction comparison. It identifies the actual projections, strict transitions, and augmentation maps from $D(r)K$. In particular the component to $\operatorname{Res}_nLj_n^*K_n$ is $D(r)$ of the canonical reduction map, followed by the normalized finite coefficient comparison, and not an arbitrary lift of that reduction map to a cone.

On the full subcategory $D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] the resulting canonical map
$$\kappa_K:D(r)K\longrightarrow Lj^*_{\mathcal O_E}K$$
is an isomorphism, natural for all derived morphisms. It is the composite of the transported canonical quotient-tower completion unit with the displayed isomorphism. It identifies the reductions and their canonical maps at every positive level. After transport of coefficient rings, the comparison of $D(r)$ with termwise restriction commutes with $Q$, the localization functor. No equivalence of ambient unbounded categories is asserted for $j$ or for completed pullback.
